title: SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
summary: Training generalizable embodied agents requires realistic, varied, and simulation-ready indoor environments. Language-guided methods support semantic planning and object-level reasoning, but precise spatial grounding remains difficult. Visual generative models offer rich priors over plausible arrangements, yet their outputs require geometric reasoning to become physically valid 3D scenes. We introduce SceneBloom, an agentic framework that combines visual layout sampling with contract-guided 3D compilation. A hierarchical sampler uses diffusion priors to generate furniture arrangements within functional zones. A compiler then uses relations extracted from each proposal to guide geometric fitting and local pose correction. Across five room types, SceneBloom attains the highest visual quality and physical stability among the compared methods and is the only method with no detected mesh collisions and out-of-bounds objects. Its layouts are also closer to the distribution of real rooms than those of all compared baselines. Object navigation policies trained in these realistic scenes achieve a higher success rate in held-out real scans than those trained on an equal number of real training scans. Code is available at https://github.com/Tinaliu0123/scenebloom.
facts: SceneBloom 是一个 agentic 框架，将视觉布局采样与契约引导的 3D 编译相结合：分层采样器利用扩散先验在功能区内生成家具布局，编译器利用从每个提案中提取的关系指导几何拟合与局部姿态修正。在五种房间类型上，该方法在视觉质量与物理稳定性上均为最高，是唯一未检测到网格碰撞和越界物体的方法，布局分布比所有基线更接近真实房间；在这些场景中训练的目标导航策略在留出真实扫描上的成功率高于用等量真实训练扫描训练的策略。代码见 https://github.com/Tinaliu0123/scenebloom。
analysis: 该工作针对具身智能训练数据瓶颈：语言引导方法语义规划强但空间落地弱，视觉生成模型先验丰富但输出需几何推理才能成为物理有效的 3D 场景。SceneBloom 用“生成提案+关系契约编译”的两段式 agentic 流程弥补这一缺口，思路清晰且可复现。关键亮点是训练数据合成质量反超真实数据训练效果，暗示合成环境在覆盖度与多样性上可能优于有限真实扫描。
technical_value: 将扩散布局先验与几何约束编译解耦，形成可插拔的仿真就绪场景生成管线；关系提取驱动的局部姿态修正可降低碰撞与越界，对 sim2real 数据合成有直接复用价值。
impact: 若结果可复现，将降低具身智能对昂贵真实扫描的依赖，推动合成数据成为导航策略训练的主流补充；对机器人仿真、游戏与室内设计自动化亦有外溢价值。

title: Green Code or Costly Code? Evaluating the Energy Costs of Iterative LLM-Based Code Optimizations
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to optimize code for performance. This practice often assumes that improvements in execution speed naturally translate into overall lower energy consumption. We challenge this assumption empirically by measuring whether performance-optimized code produced by LLM self-refinement pipelines is also energy-efficient relative to canonical human reference solutions, and whether the energy cost of the optimization process can be offset by subsequent execution-time savings. We evaluate 11 open-source models across four decoding configurations on all 1,000 problems of EffiBench, a state-of-the-art performance benchmark, while collecting per-process, hardware-level energy measurements throughout. Inference energy spans 0.79 to 8.68 MJ across model-variant pairs, which is roughly equivalent to the energy of 250 to 2800 GPT-4.1 queries. Limiting the maximum number of output tokens has the largest impact, reducing energy use by up to 69% compared to the default configuration. On the execution side, 42 of 44 configurations produce code that consumes more energy per problem than the canonical human reference, with overheads ranging from +4% to +886%. The two exceptions achieve only marginal gains, with break-even points on the order of 10^6 to 10^7 executions. Mixture-of-Experts architectures consume substantially less inference energy than equivalently-sized dense models without sacrificing correctness, making architectural choice a more consequential sustainability lever than decoding parameters. Performance optimization and energy efficiency are not always aligned goals: LLM self-refinement consistently produces faster-seeking but energy-heavier code relative to what a human engineer would write. All artifacts are available at http
facts: 研究评估 LLM 自优化代码是否真正节能：在 EffiBench 全部 1000 题上评测 11 个开源模型、4 种解码配置，并做硬件级能耗测量。推理能耗跨模型变体为 0.79 至 8.68 MJ，约相当于 250 至 2800 次 GPT-4.1 查询；限制最大输出 token 影响最大，较默认配置最多降低 69% 能耗。执行侧，44 种配置中有 42 种生成的代码每题能耗高于人类参考解，超出 +4% 至 +886%；两个例外仅边际改善，盈亏平衡需 10^6 至 10^7 次执行。MoE 架构推理能耗显著低于同规模稠密模型且不牺牲正确性。
analysis: 该研究用实测数据挑战“性能优化即节能”的默认假设，指出 LLM 自优化倾向生成更快但更耗能的代码，且优化过程本身的能耗难以被后续执行节省抵消。结论对绿色软件与 AI 编码工具评估标准有纠偏意义：应把推理能耗与执行能耗纳入统一核算。
technical_value: 提供硬件级能耗测量方法与 EffiBench 全量评测，量化解码参数与架构选择对能耗的影响，可作为后续绿色代码研究的基线。
impact: 可能推动 LLM 代码优化工具引入能耗指标，影响企业 AI 编码实践与可持续性评估；对 MoE 架构的能效优势提供实证支持。

title: Turning Database Grading into RL Rewards: Post-Training Agents with ThinkingBox
facts: 微软在 Hugging Face 博客发布 ThinkingBox 相关文章，标题为《Turning Database Grading into RL Rewards: Post-Training Agents with ThinkingBox》，摘要为空。
analysis: 核心思路是把数据库判分结果转化为强化学习奖励，用于 agent 后训练。这属于“可验证奖励”范式的延伸：数据库任务天然有确定性判分，适合作为 RL 信号，规避人工偏好标注。摘要缺失，具体方法、基准与增益无法核实，需以原文为准。
technical_value: 将结构化判分器接入 RL 训练回路，为代码/数据库类 agent 提供稠密可验证奖励，工程上可复用于 SQL 生成、数据操作等任务的后训练。
impact: 若效果显著，会强化“环境判分即奖励”的 agent 后训练路线，推动企业级数据 agent 的能力提升；但缺乏摘要，影响评估需谨慎。

title: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government collaborate to build fine-tuned AI model for scam detection
summary: Learn how Google DeepMind and GovTech Singapore uses lightweight on-device Gemma models to intercept conversational scams in private chats with zero cloud data egress.
facts: Google DeepMind 与新加坡政府科技局（GovTech）合作，使用轻量级端侧 Gemma 模型在私聊中拦截对话式诈骗，数据不出云（zero cloud data egress）。
analysis: 该合作把端侧小模型用于高隐私敏感的反诈场景，技术选型强调本地推理与数据不出设备，兼顾隐私合规与实时性。对话式诈骗检测需要理解多轮语境，对模型轻量化与准确率平衡要求高。政府合作提供了真实部署与评估渠道。
technical_value: 端侧 Gemma 微调用于对话诈骗识别，验证了小模型在隐私约束下的实用部署路径；零云数据外泄设计对合规敏感行业有参考价值。
impact: 为端侧 AI 安全应用提供政府级落地样板，可能推动更多地区采用本地化反诈模型；对 Gemma 生态的行业微调具有示范效应。

title: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
facts: Google DeepMind 发布博客介绍 EmbeddingGemma 2，称其为开放、轻量级多模态嵌入模型。摘要为空。
analysis: 多模态嵌入模型是 RAG、检索与跨模态对齐的基础设施。轻量开放定位意味着可在端侧或低成本环境部署，降低多模态检索门槛。具体参数、基准与许可未在输入中给出，需查原文。
technical_value: 开放轻量多模态嵌入可统一文本-图像检索接口，便于在边缘设备构建多模态 RAG 与语义搜索。
impact: 若性能有竞争力，将加剧开源嵌入模型竞争，利好端侧多模态检索应用生态。
